changed_surfaces.purpose: Replace direct JDBC and Java SQL construction with IssueRepository calls while retaining authorization, transaction, conflict, relation, and audit orchestration.
Provide the explicit service-to-Mapper persistence contract and result adaptation.
Declare the complete issue persistence contract.

Construct IssueService with the XML-backed Mapper fixture for existing governance scenarios.
Assert issue SQL ownership and bindings in IssueMapper.xml rather than the service layer.
